name: Sonic Resonance
description: You have the ability to control sound in several fashions. You can create semi-solid barriers, set up waves which weaken or strengthen a target, as well as creating soothing sounds which act to counteract any negative effects which may exist on your friends.

powers.name: Sonic Siphon
powers.description:
By setting up a constant vibration within the body of your foe, you drain a target of their Damage and Debuff Resistance. The target will take more damage from successful attacks and suffer stronger debuffs, and you will increase yours by the same amount.

Recharge: Slow.

powers.name: Sonic Barrier
powers.description:
This shield dramatically reduces the damage an ally takes from Smashing, Lethal, and Toxic attacks for a limited time, as well as reducing the effects of ToHit and Defense debuffs. You cannot stack multiple Sonic Barriers on the same target; however, the shield can be improved by another ally using the same power. Can also be used in conjunction with your Sonic Haven. You cannot use this power on yourself.

Recharge: Very Fast.
powers.shortHelp: Ranged, Ally +Res(Smash, Lethal, Toxic, ToHit, Def)

powers.name: Sonic Haven
powers.description:
This shield dramatically reduces the damage an ally takes from Fire, Cold, Energy, and Negative Energy attacks for a limited time, as well as protection from Endurance and Recovery debuffs. You cannot stack multiple Sonic Havens on the same target; however, the shield can be improved by another ally using the same power. Can also be used in conjunction with your Sonic Barrier. You cannot use this power on yourself.

Recharge: Very Fast.
powers.shortHelp: Ranged, Ally +Res(Fire, Cold, Energy, Negative Energy)

powers.name: Sonic Cage
powers.description:
Encases the target in an impenetrable field of sonic waves. If the target is a foe, they cannot attack or be attacked. If the target is an ally, they gain a large bonus to defense and resistance against all damage and the recharge on this power is increased.

Recharge: Slow.

powers.name: Disruption Field
powers.description:
You set up a constant wave of sonic energy around an enemy or ally, weakening the Damage Resistance of all nearby foes.

Recharge: Moderate.

powers.name: Sonic Dispersion
powers.description:
You create a large field of sonic waves, protecting all allies inside. The Sonic Dispersion gives all allies within increased Resistance against all damage except Psionic. The Sonic Bubble also protects allies from Immobilization, Disorient, and Hold effects.

Recharge: Slow.
powers.shortHelp: Toggle: PBAoE, Ally +Res(All DMG except Psionic, Hold, Immobilize, Disorient)

powers.name: Sonic Repulsion
powers.description:
You create a powerful sonic resonance around an ally, repelling all foes nearby. When repelled, foes also take minor Smashing and Energy damage.

Recharge: Moderate.
powers.shortHelp: Toggle: Ranged (Target Ally AoE), Foe Knockback, DMG (Smashing, Energy)

powers.name: Clarity
powers.description:
By bouncing a carefully pitched sound wave off an ally's ear drum, you can free them from any Disorient, Hold, Sleep, Confusion, Fear, or Immobilize effects, and leave them resistant to such effects for a good while. Protection will improve with multiple applications and as you advance in level. Clarity also provides your ally enhanced perception and resistance to psionic damage.

Recharge: Fast.
powers.shortHelp: Ally +Res(Psi, Disorient, Hold, Sleep, Immobilize, Fear, Confusion), +Perception

powers.name: Liquefy
powers.description:
You unleash a barrage of sonic waves on the Earth itself, generating a powerful, localized earthquake. The impact of the sonic shockwave may Hold some foes and deal some minor damage. Most foes that pass through the location will fall down. The violent shaking also reduces their chance to hit, Defense, and their maximum hit points.

Recharge: Very Long.
powers.shortHelp: Ranged (Location AoE), Foe Knockback, Hold, -To Hit, -DEF, -MaxHP
